title: Microstructure and mechanical properties at elevated temperatures of a new Al-containing refractory high-entropy alloy Nb-Mo-Cr-Ti-Al
process_description: prepared by arc melting elemental bulk materials with purities of Nb (99.9%), Mo (99.96%), Al (99.9%), Cr (99%), and Ti (99.8%) in equiatomic concentration under Ar base pressure of 0.6 bar. The buttons were flipped and remelted at least five times for homogenization and cast into a rod-shaped Cu mold. Heat treatments were performed at 1100°C, 1200°C, and 1300°C for 20 h under Ar flow.
